excerpt: 报告期内，公司相关设备已部署于客户 A、客户 B、客户 C、晶合集成、华润微、士兰微、三安半导体、中车时代、客户 D、华天科技、达迩科技等主流半导体厂商的先进制程和先进封装产线，并成功应用于先进制程 3D NAND Flash 存储芯片、先进制程 DRAM 存储芯片、28nm 及以下先进制程逻辑芯片、SiC 功率芯片、沟槽栅型 IGBT 功率芯片、先进电源管理芯片、BSI-CCD 芯片量产，以及国产 HBM 芯片工艺研发等前沿应用场景。
scope_note: The issuer's own sentence puts HBM in a different bucket from everything else it lists: the seven chip types before it are 量产 (volume production), and HBM is 工艺研发 (process R&D). Read the grammar, not the list -- this is not a claim of HBM production tooling. No tool model, no customer and no volume is attached to the HBM clause, and the eleven customers named at the head of the sentence are named for the deployment claim as a whole, not for HBM.

excerpt: 但随着器件精细化制造需求增长，半导体前后道工艺逐步融合并出现中道工艺（即先进封装），公司基于多年发展形成的先进精密激光相关核心技术和服务前道先进制程积累的工艺能力，针对当前半导体先进封装中三维堆叠、异构集成发展趋势开展激光剥离、激光隐形切割等新型设备研发，并与下游客户就国产HBM 制造项目开展相关技术、工艺和设备验证工作。此类技术系业内前沿探索，目前仅东京电子、EV Group 等国际大厂实现设备产品少量出货
scope_note: The strongest HBM statement in the filing: joint technical, process and equipment validation with a downstream customer on a domestic HBM manufacturing project, in laser lift-off (激光剥离) among other new tool development. Validation work, not qualification, shipment or revenue -- the issuer separately concedes its specialised-laser line has low market share and limited batch-delivery capability. The customer is unnamed. The issuer's claim that only Tokyo Electron and EV Group ship such tools, in small volumes, is its own competitive assertion and is not independently established here.

excerpt: 但随着器件精细化制造需求增长，半导体前后道工艺逐步融合并出现中道工艺（即先进封装），公司基于多年发展形成的先进精密激光相关核心技术和服务前道先进制程积累的工艺能力，针对当前半导体先进封装中三维堆叠、异构集成发展趋势开展激光剥离、激光隐形切割等新型设备研发，并与下游客户就国产HBM 制造项目开展相关技术、工艺和设备验证工作。此类技术系业内前沿探索，目前仅东京电子、EV Group 等国际大厂实现设备产品少量出货
scope_note: Same sentence and same validation work as the debonding link, recorded separately because the issuer names two distinct tool types under it: stealth dicing (激光隐形切割) alongside laser lift-off. One disclosure, two categories; do not count it as two separate customer engagements. No revenue is allocated to either category -- the whole 专用激光加工设备 line is held out of this packet's observations.

excerpt: 目前，公司已面向客户 A、客户 B、客户 C、晶合集成、华润微、士兰微、三安半导体、中车时代、客户 D、华天科技、达迩科技等主流半导体厂商的先进制造和先进封装产线需求，成功推出多款先进激光热处理设备、专用激光加工设备，应用于先进制程 3D NAND Flash 存储芯片、先进制程 DRAM 存储芯片和 28nm 及以下先进制程逻辑芯片量产，以及国产 HBM 芯片激光加工验证测试等场景。
scope_note: The business-section restatement of the p3 claim, with the HBM clause worded differently and more narrowly: 激光加工验证测试 (laser-processing validation testing) rather than 工艺研发. Both wordings keep HBM outside the 量产 list. Registered separately from the p3 link because the two pages word the maturity claim differently and an analyst should see both; it is the same underlying engagement, not extra evidence of scale.

excerpt: 储备了 3D NAND Flash 刻蚀用硬掩膜激光硬化工艺技术，先进制程 DRAM 超薄硅化物激光退火工艺技术；面向 HBM 等新型三维器件开发并储备激光修整、自选择激光剥离减薄、多层堆叠及超薄晶圆激光切割，以及 By SHOT&Full Device Exposure 激光退火等工艺技术。
scope_note: A technology reserve (储备), which is the weakest maturity word in the filing: process technologies developed and held for HBM-class 3D devices, with no tool, customer or shipment attached. Four are listed -- laser trimming, self-selective laser lift-off thinning, multi-layer and ultra-thin wafer laser dicing, and By SHOT & Full Device Exposure laser anneal -- spanning categories beyond this record's thermal_laser_anneal; the record is filed on the anneal category because that is the issuer's registered equipment line, and the other three are named in this note rather than given links of their own, since no equipment exists behind them.
